seoTitle: 💌 Love Letter Emoji Meaning - What Does 💌 Really Mean?
seoDescription: Learn what the love letter emoji 💌 really means in texts and social media.

longForm.overview:
The 💌 Love Letter emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as a white envelope with a red wax seal and a small red heart drawn on it. The visual cue reads instantly as a love letter, romantic-coded envelope, or the visible 'I am sending you a heart' tag. By 2026 💌 has become the go-to emoji for the romantic-coded envelope, the visible-'sending love' tag, and the warm-and-affection-coded default for letter-coded and DM-coded love messages.

In modern chat 💌 does very specific work. People send it as a literal love-coded envelope, as the visible 'sending you a heart' tag, or as the romantic-coded DM warm-up. The envelope-with-wax-seal-and-heart is the visual cue that the message is love-coded letter content. Writers should pick 💌 when the read is romantic love letter or warm-coded affection DM, and avoid it when the read is different — 💌 is letter-coded and implies enclosed affection.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
💌 lands on a friend's 'love you, sending this' message, in a work channel where someone is signing off warmly, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is opening with romantic-coded affection. The envelope-and-heart anchors the read.

In close-friends chats 💌 reads as the universal 'sending you a heart' tag and the romantic-coded letter default. On X the emoji punctuates 'love letter' coded tweets. The emoji pairs with ❤️ for the layered letter-and-heart stack and with 📨 for the layered envelope-and-letter pair stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 💌 in any context where the message is non-romantic. The heart-on-envelope implies enclosed affection. Avoid 💌 in ironic contexts where the love letter is faked — 🙄 fits better there.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 💌 on an affection-coded message, mirror with another 💌 or ❤️ to match the warmth. The letter-coded chain reads as solidarity.

If 💌 lands as the warm-coded default, reply with another 💌 or ❤️. And if you want to send 💌 yourself, pair it with the message so the romantic-letter read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 💌 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 💌 means love letter, romantic-coded envelope, or 'sending you a heart.' The envelope-with-wax-seal-and-heart is the visual cue that the message is love-coded letter content.

faqs.question: Is 💌 flirty?
faqs.answer: Yes. 💌 is one of the most romantic-coded emojis in the standard set. In a dating thread it reads as visible 'I am sending you a heart-coded letter.'

faqs.question: What does 💌 mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: From a guy or anyone, 💌 carries the same romantic-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 💌 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram, 💌 is the default sticker on romantic-coded captions and DM-coded love-letter story overlays.
